sections.markdown:
## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: graduated licensing for drivers under eighteen
Knowledge facts: part C holds 40 fact blocks (sec03-F01 onward) from physical pages 28 to 34; part C2 holds 16 confusable and continuation blocks (sec03-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states the issuer, the July 1, 2022 content date, the multiple-choice format and its four roughly equal topic areas, the vision standard and the one-day retake wait from physical pages 3, 35 and 36; question count, passing score and time limit are unknown.
VERIFY list:
- TN-GDL-A-EXAM — question count, passing score and time limit not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- TN-GDL-A-FRESH — content dated July 1, 2022; current edition and liveness unconfirmed (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- TN-GDL-D-WINDOW — Intermediate Restricted points look-back: twelve months versus the hundred-and-eighty days before applying (owner HallucinationAuditor).
- TN-GDL-D-POINTS — Unrestricted points limit: more than six versus six or more (owner HallucinationAuditor).
- TN-GDL-D-FEE — Intermediate Restricted fee differs between two manual tables (owner HallucinationAuditor).
- TN-GDL-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- TN-GDL-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: GDL fees, form numbers, school-certificate procedures and the cell phone penalty amounts (for example sec03-F31, sec03-F33, sec03-F34) can change and must be refreshed from the Department of Safety and Homeland Security website.

corpus_stability.reason: The Tennessee Comprehensive Driver License Manual says its content is current as of July 1, 2022 and its back cover carries one March 2025 print authorization; nothing in the selected pages suggests more than one rewrite per year, but the content date is old, so freshness is held as debt rather than assumed.
